lines.text: Three days after arriving in the province, Festus went up from Caesarea to Jerusalem, where leaders asked him to summon Paul.
Festus refused to summon Paul and told the leaders to come down to Caesarea and accuse him there.
After eight or ten days in Jerusalem, Festus went down to Caesarea and had Felix brought in, where the Jews brought many charges.
Paul said he had committed no offense, and when Festus asked him to go to Jerusalem, Paul said he ought to be tried before Caesar.
Paul said no one could hand him over to the Jews, and Festus conferred with his council and agreed he would go to Herod.
